title: Transverse vibration of a tensioned rectangular bar
source: Independent Euler–Bernoulli clamped-clamped beam with axial tension; roots are evaluated by the standard-library bisection in reference.py.

quantities.reason: The independent Euler–Bernoulli clamped-clamped tensioned-beam root is the reference. The dimensionless beam-model estimate is 0.13% for the corresponding zero-tension weak-axis first mode, while the measured solid-versus-beam differences are 0.20% without tension and 0.09% with tension; axial tension reduces the bending fraction. The 0.5% band is about twice the larger measured difference for this mode family.

The independent Euler–Bernoulli clamped-clamped tensioned-beam root is the reference. The dimensionless beam-model estimate is 0.51% for the corresponding zero-tension strong-axis first mode, while the measured solid-versus-beam differences are 0.85% without tension and 0.52% with tension; axial tension reduces the bending fraction. The 1.5% band is about twice the larger measured difference for this mode family.

The independent Euler–Bernoulli clamped-clamped tensioned-beam root is the reference. The dimensionless beam-model estimate is 0.35% for the corresponding zero-tension weak-axis second mode, while the measured solid-versus-beam differences are 0.46% without tension and 0.21% with tension; axial tension reduces the bending fraction. The 1% band is about twice the larger measured difference for this mode family.

The independent Euler–Bernoulli clamped-clamped beam root is the reference. The 0.5% band is about twice the measured difference and covers the beam-model applicability error.
